label: JSON and YAML with prettier
description: Checks the formatting of JSON and YAML files (*.json, *.yml, *.yaml) anywhere in the project with prettier --check and the project's own prettier configuration. The files prettier would reformat are located findings; nothing is rewritten. Comes in by evidence: a JSON or YAML file in any folder; runs where format-check is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available).
